_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both land on a HOLD-equivalent stance (Analyst explicitly HOLD, Narrative implies patience), but they diverge on interpretation: Analyst says the analog is noise, Narrative says it's constructive compression. I side with the Analyst's stricter read given the divergences and the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00).
next_move.confirmed_if: Score remains 39-46 with funding and VIX stable but elevated, no breakout in CVD or exchange netflow — HOLD validated as the coil persists.
